name: NGC 3384-DF3 (Hubble)
blurb: M96-DF3, a faint low surface brightness galaxy in the M96 group, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3384df3-hubble
story: A faint, diffuse galaxy in deep Dragonfly images of the M96 group, cataloged before as LeG 9. Hubble resolved its stars and confirmed that it lies at the group's distance.

claims.text: The object was selected from deep optical imaging with the Dragonfly Telephoto Array and imaged with HST/ACS
M96-DF3 is also cataloged as [KK2004] LeG 9
The M96 field of the survey was centered on NGC 3384 in the M96 group
The Hubble target NGC3384-DF3 is at RA 10 42 34.59, Dec +12 09 2.06, the position of M96-DF3
All galaxies in the M96 field, including M96-DF3, are at the distance of the M96 group
